[[File:Lefranieclipse.png|thumb|200px|Darth Vader watches as Priate is eclipsed by [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]].]]
'''Priate''',<ref name="TEA" /> also called '''Mustafar''', was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]]. At times, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]] eclipsed the view of this star from the world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>
